title: Product compactification geometry, exchange factorization and open counit square
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $k,A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Use ordinary unbounded constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small pro-etale sites, with $P_v=Lv^*$, $R_v=Rv_*$, derived tensor $\otimes=\otimes_A^L$ and signed symmetry $\sigma$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let $f:X\to B$, $g:Z\to B$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and choose compactifications $f=aj$, $g=bk$, with opens $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$, $k:Z\hookrightarrow\bar Z$ and proper maps $a:\bar X\to B$, $b:\bar Z\to B$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Put $P=X\times_BZ$, $C=\bar X\times_B\bar Z$, $W=\bar X\times_BZ$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to Z$, $r:C\to\bar X$, $t:C\to\bar Z$, $v:W\to Z$, $i:W\hookrightarrow C$, $j_q:P\hookrightarrow W$ for the canonical projections and opens; put $u=ij_q$, $h=fp=gq$, $c=bt=ar$. For $M\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $N\in D^+(Z_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ equipped with etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], set $H=j_!M$, $J=k_!N$, $D=P_pM\otimes P_qN$, $F=P_rH$, $E=P_iF$, $K=j_{q!}P_pM$, $K_D=j_{q!}D$, $m=i_!K$, $L=R_aH$ and $L_0=P_bL$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Use the specified counit-defined maps $\pi,\operatorname{Ex}_*,\operatorname{Ex}_!,\operatorname{PF}$ of [def-exchange-projection]. All omitted tensor, pullback and direct-image compositors are canonical; the direct-image compositor is $\kappa_{b,t}:R_c\xrightarrow{\sim}R_bR_t$ [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition].

Use the unit-normalized open base change $\beta:E\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ and open tensor maps $\delta_{o;Q,V}:o_!Q\otimes V\xrightarrow{\sim}o_!(Q\otimes P_oV)$ of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], and the normalized proper/open mate $\Gamma:k_!R_v\to R_ti_!$ of [lem-sf-proper-open-tensor-compatibility]. Write $\epsilon_o:o_!P_o\to1$ for the open-adjunction counit. Set $A_0=\operatorname{Ex}_{*,a,b,H}:L_0\to R_tF$, and let $B_0=\operatorname{Ex}_{!,f,g,M}:P_kL_0\to R_vK$ use the compactification $(j,a)$ and its base change $(j_q,v)$. Put $\chi=\epsilon_{i,F}i_!(\beta^{-1}):m\to F$ and $s=\Gamma_Kk_!(B_0):k_!P_kL_0\to R_tm$.

The maps $v,t$ are proper, $i,j_q,k,u$ are quasi-compact open immersions, all displayed schemes are Noetherian finite-type $k$-schemes, $(j_q,v)$ compactifies $q$, and $(u,c)$ compactifies $h$. With the normalized open restriction $\rho_F:P_kR_tF\xrightarrow{\sim}R_vP_iF$ of [lem-exc-proetale-derived-open-restriction], the specified maps satisfy
$$\rho_F=\operatorname{Ex}_{*,t,k,F},\qquad B_0=R_v(\beta)\rho_FP_k(A_0),\qquad R_t(\chi)s=A_0\epsilon_{k,L_0}.$$
More explicitly, for $E=P_iF$, let $\lambda_E:P_kR_ti_!E\xrightarrow{\rho}R_vP_ii_!E\xrightarrow{\sim}R_vE$ use the open unit. The mate $\Gamma_E$ is the $k_!\dashv P_k$ adjunct of $\lambda_E^{-1}$, and
$$\rho_FP_k\bigl(R_t(\epsilon_{i,F})\Gamma_E\bigr)=1_{R_vE},\qquad R_t(\epsilon_{i,F})\Gamma_Ek_!(\rho_F)=\epsilon_{k,R_tF}.$$
These formulas insert the canonical open unit identifications. On any bounded-below etale-origin object $Q$ on $P$, the composition comparison $\alpha_{g,q,Q}$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition], in the coordinates $Rg_!=R_bk_!$, $Rq_!=R_vj_{q!}$, $Rh_!=R_cu_!$, is $\kappa_{b,t}^{-1}R_b(\Gamma_{j_{q!}Q})$, followed by $i_!j_{q!}\cong u_!$. No invertibility of a proper projection, exchange, or $\Gamma$ on arbitrary ambient objects is asserted.

proof.text: Construct Noetherian instances for B,X,Z over the field and for each compactification and fibre product by finite-type maps. Existing stability instances give proper maps, quasi-compact opens, and all finite-type structure maps. Assemble Geometry by conjunction.

Apply productOpenAdjunctionNormalization to F. Compose its adjunct equation for Gamma_E with P_k R_t(epsilon_i) and rho; the last two maps are lambda, so inverse cancellation gives the first counit identity. The adjunct of k_!(rho) followed by Gamma_E and R_t(epsilon_i) is identity by Hom-equivalence naturality; injectivity of that equivalence gives the second counit identity. These are the complete private proof counits_of_normalization.

Naturality of properOpenMate at beta inverse moves it past R_t i_!(beta inverse). Substitute productHorizontalExchangeFactorization, cancel beta followed by beta inverse under R_v and k_!, apply the second counit identity and finally counit naturality at A0. This proves the counit square, with no new hole, in counit_square_of_factorization. Assemble Equations from this square and the two normalization lemmas.

Apply productCompositionCoordinateComparison to each Q and its retained etale-origin witness, using the Noetherian instances already constructed. Assemble the three conclusions of the unchanged theorem.
